DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知に書かれた持ち物を確かめたいのですね。どの行をご覧でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check what the notice says to bring. Which line were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 別紙を記入して持参とありますが、この一枚しか持ってきていません。封筒の中にもう一枚あったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本文一枚だけ持参し別紙が封筒にあったかもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to fill in and bring an attached sheet, but I brought only this one page. There may have been another sheet inside the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought only the main page and the attachment may have been in the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本文と別紙の役割を確認しましょう。今日は記入したものを提出する予定でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the roles of the main page and the attachment. Were you planning to submit the completed form today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日出せると思って来ました。でも何を記入するのか分からず、名前だけ書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日提出できると思い内容が不明で名前だけ記入したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I came thinking I could submit it today. But I did not understand what to fill in, so I have written only my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you expected to submit it today but wrote only your name because the contents were unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今ある紙だけで提出内容を決めず、担当へ確認しましょう。期限の表示はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the responsible staff member rather than deciding what to submit from this page alone. Where is the deadline shown?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 下に日付がありますが、相談する期限か提出する期限か分かりません。その意味も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知の日付が相談か提出の期限かを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a date at the bottom, but I do not know whether it is the deadline to consult or to submit. I would like to ask what it means too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the date on the notice is the consultation or submission deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に期限と不足する別紙を尋ねます。ご自宅に封筒は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the staff member about the deadline and the missing attachment. Do you still have the envelope at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒は机の引き出しに残しています。帰って別紙を探し、見つからなければ連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒を引き出しで探し別紙がなければ連絡したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I kept the envelope in a desk drawer. I would like to look for the attachment when I get home and contact them if I cannot find it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to look in the drawer for the envelope and contact them if the attachment is missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡する際の番号と担当名を、通知で確かめておきましょう。質問をメモできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the contact number and the responsible person's name on the notice. Can you make a note of your questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別紙の名前、記入する内容、日付の意味をメモします。封筒を見てから、担当に不足を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別紙名と記入内容と日付の意味を記録し不足を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the name of the attachment, what to fill in, and what the date means. After checking the envelope, I will discuss the missing item with the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record the attachment's name, required entries and date's meaning, and ask about the missing item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本文をお返ししますので、封筒と一緒に保管してください。担当への質問も整理できましたね。また確認が必要になりましたらお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will return the main page, so please keep it with the envelope. You have organized your questions for the staff member too. Please come again if you need further confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初診の受付を進めます。説明を聞くときに、配慮してほしいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will proceed with registration for your first visit. Is there anything we should accommodate when explaining things to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最近、右耳で言葉を聞き取りにくいです。待合室で呼ばれても気づかないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右耳の聞こえにくさで待合室の呼出しを逃すかもしれないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Recently I have had difficulty hearing speech with my right ear. I may not notice being called in the waiting room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that difficulty hearing with your right ear may cause you to miss the waiting-room call. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞き取りにくいことを受付と診療担当へ伝えます。症状をメモにして来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell reception and the medical staff about your hearing difficulty. Did you bring a note of your symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いつ気づいたかを書いたメモがあります。先週からだと思いますが、日付ははっきり覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先週からというメモを持参したが日付は曖昧だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a note about when I noticed it. I think it started last week, but I do not clearly remember the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought a note saying last week but are unsure of the date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままの記憶を担当者へ伝えましょう。今ここでの説明は聞き取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the responsible staff member exactly what you remember. Can you hear the explanation here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 静かなところでは聞けています。周りの声が重なると分からなくなるので、一つずつ話していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 静かなら聞けるが声が重なると難しく一つずつ話してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can hear in a quiet place. When voices overlap, I lose track, so it would help if you explained one thing at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you can hear in quiet but have trouble with overlapping voices, and request one thing at a time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 区切って説明します。持参された書類も、順に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain in separate parts. Let us also check the documents you brought in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類とメモを別々に持っています。症状のメモは受付で渡すのか、診療のときに見せるのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類と別の症状メモを受付か診療で渡すか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the documents and the note separately. Please tell me whether to hand the symptom note in at reception or show it during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether to give the separate symptom note at reception or during the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 症状の情報を担当へつなげる方法を確認します。呼出しの対応も、待合室へ移動する前に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check how to pass the symptom information to the responsible staff. Let us also discuss arrangements for calling you before you go to the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモを見ていただき、呼出しの方法を確認してから待ちます。聞き取れない説明は、その場で聞き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモと呼出し方法を確認して待ち不明な説明を聞き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait after you look at the note and we confirm how I will be called. If I cannot hear an explanation, I will ask again on the spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the note and calling method before waiting, and ask again about unclear explanations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では書類から一つずつ拝見します。待つ場所と呼出しを確認したらご案内しますので、またお声がけするまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will look at your documents one by one first. Once we confirm where to wait and how to call you, I will guide you, so please wait until I speak to you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵をお届けに来られたのですね。ご自分のものではないと気づいた経緯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come to hand in some keys. Please explain how you realized they were not yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買い物袋を家で開けたら、見知らぬ鍵が入っていました。どこで入ったのかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家で袋を開け鍵を見つけたが入った場所は不明だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened my shopping bag at home, I found unfamiliar keys inside. I do not know where they got into the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found the keys when opening the bag at home, but do not know where they got in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入った場所と、発見した場所を分けて記録しましょう。買い物をした店は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us record separately where they got in and where you found them. Do you remember which shops you used?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一軒のスーパーだけです。会計の後、袋詰めの台で自分の袋を広げました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一軒のスーパーで会計後に袋詰め台で自分の袋を広げたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just one supermarket. After paying, I spread out my own bag on the packing counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you shopped at one supermarket and opened your own bag at the packing counter after paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋詰めをした場所が手がかりになりますね。鍵を見つけた時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The place where you packed your shopping is a useful lead. Do you know what time you found the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家に着いてすぐなので、午後四時ごろです。店を出たのはその三十分ほど前でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家で四時ごろ発見し退店は三十分前だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was just after I got home, around four in the afternoon. I had left the shop about thirty minutes earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found them at home around four and left the shop thirty minutes before that. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの時刻を分けて伺います。鍵の特徴は、ここへ来る前に確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record the two times separately. Did you check the keys' features before coming here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二本の鍵に丸い札が付いていました。札の名前は読まず、使ってみることもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二本に丸い札があり名前を読まず使っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There were two keys with a round tag. I did not read the name on the tag or try using the keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain there were two keys and a round tag, and you neither read the name nor used them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態でお預かりします。店で混ざったと断定せず、覚えている経緯を残しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take them as they are. Let us record what you remember without concluding that they got mixed in at the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で見つけたことと、店では袋詰めをしたことを別に伝えます。入った場所は不明だと記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見と袋詰めを分け鍵が入った場所は不明と記録してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish finding them at home from packing my bag at the shop. Please record that where they got in is unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to record the discovery and packing separately, and that the entry location is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分からない部分も区別して伺えました。必要な確認を続けます。お届けありがとうございます。帰宅の際もどうぞお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have also distinguished the parts you do not know. We will continue the necessary checks. Thank you for bringing them in, and please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越し後の郵便についてですね。住所のどの部分が変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about your mail after moving. Which part of your address has changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ建物の別の部屋に移りました。町名と番地は同じなので、手続きが必要か迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町名と番地は同じで部屋だけ変わり手続きに迷うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved to another room in the same building. The area name and street number are the same, so I am unsure whether any procedure is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say only the room changed while the area and street number stayed the same, so you are unsure about procedures. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新旧の情報を区別して確認しましょう。建物名も変わっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish the old and new details. Has the building name stayed the same too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物名も同じです。部屋番号だけが二百二号室から三百五号室に変わりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物名は同じで二百二から三百五へ変わったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The building name is the same. Only the room number changed from 202 to 305.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the building name is unchanged and the room changed from 202 to 305. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号の違いを正確に伝えて、案内を確認しましょう。旧住所宛ての郵便はもう届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us give the precise difference in numbers and check the guidance. Has any mail addressed to the old room arrived yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前の部屋の住人から一通渡されました。これからも頼んでよいのか分からないので、正式な案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧部屋の住人から一通受け取り今後頼む代わりに正式案内を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The resident of my former room handed me one letter. I do not know whether I can keep asking them, so I would like the official guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you received one letter from the old room's resident and want official guidance instead of relying on them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今後の郵便について、利用できる手続きを調べます。新しい部屋へ移った日は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the available procedures for future mail. Do you know the day you moved to the new room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月の初めです。日付のメモもあります。前の部屋と今の部屋を、同じ紙に書いて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今月初めの転居日と新旧住所を同じ紙に記したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the beginning of this month. I have a note of the date too. I wrote the old and current rooms on the same paper and brought it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the move at the start of this month and both addresses are noted on one sheet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙の情報を順に照合しましょう。郵便の届出だけでなく、差出人への連絡も進めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us compare the details on the paper in order. Besides the postal notification, have you also been notifying senders?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通販の住所は変えましたが、勤め先にはまだ伝えていません。部屋番号まで含めた新住所を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通販は変更済みだが勤務先へ部屋番号込みの新住所を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I changed my online-shopping address, but I have not told my employer yet. I will give them the new address including the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say online shopping is updated but you will tell your employer the full new address, including the room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二つの部屋番号を確かめて、手続きの案内をお見せします。紙をお持ち帰りになり、連絡の際もご確認ください。またお困りでしたらご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the two room numbers and show you the procedure instructions. Please take your paper home and refer to it when contacting people too. Come and ask again if you have any problems.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所を変更されるのですね。連絡先の情報も合わせて確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are changing your address. Would you also like to check your contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所だけ変えるつもりでしたが、登録した携帯も今は使えません。番号の変更も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所だけでなく使えない旧携帯番号も変更したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only planned to change my home address, but I can no longer use the registered mobile number either. I would like to ask about changing that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change both your address and the old mobile number that no longer works. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所と電話番号を分けて確認しましょう。新しい番号を見られるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the address and phone number separately. Do you have something that shows your new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯の設定画面で見られます。暗記していないので、画面を見ながら書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暗記していない新番号を設定画面で見て書きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see it in my phone's settings. I do not know it by heart, so I would like to write it while looking at the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to copy the new number from settings because you have not memorized it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正確な番号を確認して記入しましょう。郵便で届く通知の送り先についても希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us confirm the exact number before writing it. Do you also have a preference for the address used for notices sent by post?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の自宅へ送ってほしいです。古い住所や使えない番号へ連絡が行かないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅へ通知してほしく旧住所と旧番号への連絡が心配だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want them sent to my current home. I am worried they may contact my old address or the number I cannot use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want notices sent home and are worried about contact through the old address or number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更する項目と反映の確認方法を、手続きの案内で説明します。今回相談する情報をまとめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain which items to change and how to check they have taken effect using the procedure instructions. Can you summarize the information you are asking about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅住所と携帯番号の二つです。メールアドレスは変わっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所と携帯を変えメールは変わらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two things: my home address and mobile number. My email address has not changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are changing the address and mobile number, but not the email address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その三つを区別して確認します。手続き後の連絡について、確認したい点も書いておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will distinguish and check those three items. Let us also note what you want to confirm about contact after the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新住所と新番号が記録されたか、どこで確かめるか聞きたいです。メールは変更しないと明記します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新住所と新番号の記録を確かめる方法を聞きメール不変更を明記すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to ask where to check whether the new address and number have been recorded. I will clearly state that my email is not changing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask how to confirm the new address and number were recorded and explicitly mark email unchanged. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 項目ごとに見直してから進めましょう。確認の案内もお持ちください。今日は連絡先のご相談にお越しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us review each item before proceeding. Please take the confirmation instructions too. Thank you for coming today to discuss your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つの容器を見比べていますね。どの違いを確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing two containers. Which difference would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見た目が似ていますが、片方は冷凍の売り場にありました。家の冷凍庫がいっぱいなので、保存表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た容器の一方が冷凍売場にあり家の冷凍庫が満杯で表示を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: They look similar, but one was in the frozen-food section. My freezer at home is full, so I want to check the storage label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say one similar container was in frozen foods and you want to check storage because your freezer is full. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの保存欄を探しましょう。冷蔵庫には置ける予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us find each product's storage section. Are you expecting to have space in your refrigerator?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 冷蔵庫には空きがあります。ただ、冷凍の品を冷蔵に移してよいとは考えず、表示どおりに選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 冷蔵には空きがあるが冷凍品を移せると決めず表示に従うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is space in the refrigerator. However, I do not assume a frozen product can be moved there; I want to choose according to the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the refrigerator has space, but you will follow the label without assuming frozen food can go there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扱いが違う可能性があるので、商品ごとに確認しましょう。原材料の違いも気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Their handling may differ, so let us check each product. Are you also concerned about differences in the ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ料理に使いたいので、味付け済みか知りたいです。原材料と調理の説明のどちらを見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ料理に使うため味付け済みかを原材料と調理説明で確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to use it for the same dish, so I want to know if it is already seasoned. Should I look at the ingredients or the cooking instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about checking seasoning in the ingredients and cooking instructions for use in the same dish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方を見て内容を確かめましょう。保存できる品を選んでから、使い方を比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us look at both to check the contents. After choosing something you can store, you can compare how to use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一度で全部使い切れないと思います。開けた後についての表示も探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使い切れないため開けた後の表示を見たいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not think I can use it all at once. I would like to find the instructions for after opening too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want the after-opening label because you cannot finish it all. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封後の説明を確認し、不明な点は商品の問い合わせ先へ尋ねられます。買う量も考えてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the after-opening instructions; if anything is unclear, you can ask the product's contact service. Let us also consider how much to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存と開封後の説明を読み、使い切れる量か考えます。分からなければ、今日はその品を選ばずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存と開封後と量を考え不明な品は今日は選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read the storage and after-opening instructions and consider whether I can use up that amount. If I do not understand, I will leave that product unchosen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consider storage, after-opening use and quantity, and not choose an unclear product today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは二つの表示を順に見ましょう。納得できる品を選んでくださいね。お買い物の続きもゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us look at the two labels in order. Please choose a product you feel satisfied with, and take your time with the rest of your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で散歩の道を選んでいらっしゃいますか。どんな歩き方をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the two of you choosing a walking route? What sort of walk would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は速く歩きたいのですが、私はゆっくり休みながら歩きたいです。途中で合流できる場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 速く歩く友人と休みながら歩く自分が合流する場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend wants to walk fast, but I want to go slowly with breaks. We are looking for a place to meet along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a place where a fast-walking friend and you, taking breaks, can meet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別々に歩く時間を作る案ですね。離れた後に連絡する方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you are considering some time walking separately. Do you have a way to contact each other after separating?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人とも携帯があります。でも場所を間違えないよう、同じ目印を決めておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯はあるが同じ場所を認識するため共通の目印を決めたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We both have phones. But to avoid getting the location wrong, I would like us to agree on the same landmark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have phones but want a shared landmark so you recognize the same meeting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図にある休憩広場を候補にできます。そこまでの道は現地の表示で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The rest plaza on the map could be an option. Please confirm the route there using the signs on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 広場までが長ければ、私は途中で戻るかもしれません。入口へ戻る道も先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広場が遠ければ戻るかもしれず入口への道を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the plaza is too far, I may turn back partway. I would like to know the way back to the entrance beforehand too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you may turn back if the plaza is far and want to know the way to the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口と広場の位置を見ておきましょう。無理せず戻る場合、友人へどう知らせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check where the entrance and plaza are. If you decide to turn back rather than push yourself, how will you tell your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場へ行かず入口で待つと電話します。何も言わずに待つ場所を変えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口で待つと電話し無連絡で待機場所を変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will call and say I am waiting at the entrance instead of going to the plaza. I will not change the waiting place without saying anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will call to wait at the entrance and will not change the waiting place without contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待ち合わせ場所の変更を共有すれば、探し合わずに済みますね。今日の経路は短く始めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sharing a change of meeting place saves you from searching for each other. Will you start with a short route today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初は短い道を一緒に歩きます。その後は広場を目印にし、戻る場合だけ電話で場所を変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短い道から一緒に始め広場を目印に戻る場合は電話すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will walk a short path together first. After that, we will use the plaza as our landmark and change the meeting place by phone only if I turn back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will start together on a short path, use the plaza as a landmark and call if turning back. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お互いのペースを相談できましたね。地図をお二人で確かめてから出発してください。それぞれに気持ちのよい散歩になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have discussed each other's pace. Please both check the map before setting off. I hope you each have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベビーカーでご乗車ですね。改札に入る前にご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are traveling with a stroller. Shall I guide you before you enter the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。普通の改札は狭く見えます。子どもを乗せたまま通れる所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーに子どもを乗せたまま通る場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. The regular gates look narrow. I want to check where I can pass with my child still in the stroller.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check where you can pass with the child remaining in the stroller. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通る場所を見てからご案内します。ご利用になる列車の案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check where you can pass before guiding you. Could you show me your information about the train you will use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この乗車のメモです。行き先はわかりますが、ホームの番号をまだ確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行き先のメモを提示し未確認のホーム番号を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is my note for the journey. I know the destination, but have not confirmed the platform number yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the destination note and ask about the unconfirmed platform number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列車とホームを確認しましょう。エレベーターを使う経路も合わせて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the train and platform. I will also guide you along a route using the elevator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段を避けたいので、その経路を教えてください。改札を通った後に迷わないよう、図で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改札後に階段を避けるエレベーターの道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to avoid stairs, so please show me that route. I want to see it on a map so I do not get lost after passing the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the elevator route that avoids stairs after the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図で改札から順に確認します。利用状況も確かめますので、こちらの端でお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check from the gates onward on the map. I will check availability too, so could you wait at this side?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通る方の邪魔にならない端で待ちます。列車が近づいても、確認前に急いで改札へ進まないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を妨げない場所で確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait at the side where I do not obstruct people. Even if the train is approaching, I should not rush toward the gates before checking, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for confirmation somewhere that does not obstruct passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず案内を受けてから進みましょう。時間が合わなくなった場合も、次の案内をこちらで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us proceed after receiving guidance first. If the timing no longer works, we can check the next travel information here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通れる改札とホーム、エレベーターの経路を確かめてから進みます。間に合わせようと無理にベビーカーを持ち上げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札とホームと経路の案内後に無理なく進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the accessible gate, platform and elevator route before going ahead. I will not force myself to lift the stroller to catch the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed without overexertion after guidance on the gates, platform and route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、利用状況と列車の案内を確認してきます。端でお待ちください。案内後もお気を付けてご移動ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will go check availability and the train information. Please wait at the side, and take care as you move around after receiving guidance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入に関するご相談ですね。どなたのお引っ越しについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about registering after moving here. Whose move is it about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と家族の分です。私は先週引っ越しましたが、家族は来月来る予定です。一度に相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は既に転居し家族は来月予定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mine and my family's. I moved last week, but my family plans to come next month. Can I discuss both at once?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have already moved and your family plans to come next month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談内容は一緒に伺えますが、実際のお引っ越しの状況を分けて担当へ伝えましょう。ご家族の日程は確定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can hear both questions together, but please tell the responsible staff separately about the actual situations. Is your family's date confirmed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の日はまだ決まっていません。申込書に同じ日を書いてしまわず、予定だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ日として書かず家族の予定が未定と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Their day is not decided yet. I do not want to write the same date on the application; I want to explain that theirs is still a plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not write the same date because your family's plans are not fixed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未確定の点をそのように伝えてください。今日手続きできる内容と、後で確認する内容を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain the unconfirmed part that way. The staff member will explain what can be processed today and what needs checking later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は先週住み始めたので、自分の分を先に相談したいです。持ってきた書類を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に住み始めた自分の手続きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I started living here last week, so I would like to ask about my own procedures first. Could you look at the documents I brought?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask first about procedures for yourself, since you have already started living here. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当窓口で確認しましょう。ご家族については、今お持ちの情報だけで何がわかるかも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check at the responsible counter. For your family, you can also ask what can be established from the information you currently have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族が後で来る場合の持ち物を聞きたいです。私がまとめて提出できるとは考えず、誰が来る必要があるかも尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち物と提出や来庁をする人を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to ask what my family should bring when they come later. I will not assume I can submit everything together; I will also ask who needs to come in person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to bring and who must submit or visit the office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれについて担当に相談してください。ご自身の実際の日と、ご家族の予定を別のメモにしておくと伝えやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult the staff member about each case. Writing your actual moving date and your family's plans in separate notes will help you explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の引越し日と家族の予定を分けて書きます。自分の書類を先に相談し、家族の持ち物と来庁する人を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの日程を別に記録し担当窓口へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my moving date and my family's plans separately. I will ask about my own documents first, then check what my family needs to bring and who must visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the two schedules separately and consult the responsible counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況がわかりました。担当窓口へその二つのメモをお持ちください。こちらでのご相談、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand the situation. Please take those two notes to the responsible counter. Thank you for consulting us here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約日のご相談と伺いました。変更を考えている理由をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like to discuss your appointment date. Please tell me why you are considering a change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を一緒に聞く家族が、その日に来られなくなりました。受診を別の日へ変えられるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族が来られず受診日変更を考えていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The family member who was going to listen to the explanation with me can no longer come that day. I would like to ask whether my visit can be moved to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are considering changing the visit date because your family member cannot come. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ相談しましょう。ご家族が来られないことと、予約を変えたいことを分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us consult the responsible staff. We will check separately that your family member cannot come and that you would like to change the appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人で説明を聞けるなら、元の日に来ることも考えています。わからない言葉をその場で聞き返せるか相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で説明を聞く際の聞き返しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I can hear the explanation alone, I am also considering coming on the original day. May I ask about being able to ask again on the spot when I do not understand a word?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the chance to ask again when hearing an explanation alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 説明の際のご希望も担当へ伝えます。ご家族と一緒に来る場合の候補日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will also tell the staff your preferences for the explanation. Are there possible dates when your family member could come with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族は来週の午後なら来られるそうです。ただ、その日に受診できるとは決めず、候補として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週午後を確定日ではなく希望として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: They say they can come in the afternoons next week. But please convey it as a possible option, without assuming I can be seen then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present next week's afternoons as a preference rather than a confirmed date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 候補として承ります。元の予約をどう扱うかは、担当の確認が済んでからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will take it as an option. We will explain what happens to the original appointment after the staff's checks are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、元の予約を自分で取り消さずに待ちます。話の内容を記録するメモも持参したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約を残して確認を待ちメモを使いたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will wait without canceling the original appointment myself. I would also like to bring a notebook to record what is discussed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to keep the appointment while waiting for confirmation and use notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモを使いたいというご希望も伝えましょう。ほかに説明を受ける際に心配なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us also convey that you would like to use notes. Is there anything else worrying you about receiving the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は、聞き返しとメモのことが心配です。元の日に一人で受診する案と、家族と候補日に来る案を担当に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人で来る案と家族同伴の候補を担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: For now, I am worried about asking again and taking notes. I would like to discuss with the staff both coming alone on the original day and coming with my family member on a possible date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss both coming alone and a possible date with your family member with the responsible staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの案とご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。予約変更が決まったわけではありませんので、確認後の案内をお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the two options and your wishes to the staff member. The appointment change has not been decided, so please wait for guidance after confirmation. Thank you for discussing it with us.
